note: llms_txt serves a dynamic /llms.txt Markdown file (route llms_txt.llms_txt, public, text/markdown). Its body is llms_txt.settings.content (a tokenised text value, edited on the config form at /admin/content/llms-txt) followed by published llms_txt_section content entities (title + Markdown content, ordered by weight), rendered as '## Title' blocks. It adds a token type llms_txt_markdown_menu (one token per menu) that renders a menu as a Markdown list, and llms_txt_views tokens only when markdownify_views is enabled (it is NOT installed here). Permission: 'administer llms.txt configuration'. Medium cases write a known config body / a known section and ask the agent to read it back; hard cases require the agent to create a published section and to set the llms.txt body, verified against live config/entities. Cleanups restore the shipped default body (# [site:name] / [site:slogan]) explicitly and delete only the eval's own titled sections.

evals.prompt: What URL does the Drupal llms_txt module serve, what content type does it return, and what is that file for?
evals.expected_output: It serves /llms.txt (route llms_txt.llms_txt) returning text/markdown - a machine-readable 'homepage for LLMs' that helps large language models and AI agents understand the site's content.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with llms_txt, where is the main body of the /llms.txt file stored and where do you edit it in the admin?
evals.expected_output: The main body is llms_txt.settings.content (a tokenised text value), edited on the config form at /admin/content/llms-txt (route llms_txt.llms_txt_config, permission 'administer llms.txt configuration'). Published llms_txt_section entities are appended after it.

evals.prompt: The llms_txt module lets you embed a Drupal menu into the llms.txt output as Markdown. Which token type does it provide for that, and how do you reference a specific menu?
evals.expected_output: The token type llms_txt_markdown_menu, with one token per menu, e.g. [llms_txt_markdown_menu:main], renders that menu as a nested Markdown link list.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live llms_txt configuration and report the current body content configured for the /llms.txt file.
evals.expected_output: llms_txt.settings.content is '# LLMS_TXT_EVAL_MARKER\n\nMachine index for AI agents.'

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a published llms.txt section entity. Inspect the live llms_txt_section entities and report the title of the published section.
evals.expected_output: There is a published llms_txt_section with title 'LLMS Eval Docs'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site with the llms_txt module, add a new section to the /llms.txt file titled 'API Reference' (with some Markdown content) and make sure it is published so it appears in the output. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A published llms_txt_section entity exists with title 'API Reference' (create it at /admin/content/llms-txt/add-section or via the llms_txt_section storage with status = 1).

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site I want the AI file at /llms.txt to start with the heading '# Acme AI Index'. Using the llms_txt module, set the main llms.txt body so it contains that heading. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: llms_txt.settings.content contains '# Acme AI Index' (set it on /admin/content/llms-txt or via the config object).
